title: 第265章 炼气士第264章 大声些
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：西游：刚准备尸解成仙，猴子来找第一卷：默认第265章炼气士（..la）白鹿踱了两步，忽地收了那副洋自得的神色，歪着头将小参又打量了一遍，开口道：“我且问你，你这草木之身，化形至今，修的是个甚么法门？”
小参闻言，两只小手搅在一处，嗫嚅道：“我……我也没个法门。不过是寻个灵气充裕的山头，夜里吞些月华，白日里收些日精，就这般胡乱修了千把年。”
白鹿两只前蹄往地上一顿，鼻中重喷出一口白气：“难怪你这般不济事！千年修行，连个人仙也不如，若是遇到那些厉害的人仙，恐怕只有被抓去炼丹的份。你这般修法，再修一千年，也不过是个散修野鬼，遇着个手段厉害些的，照旧拿你，你还不是没奈何。”
小参被它说得面红耳赤，低着头不敢接话，只拿脚尖去蹭地上的松针。
白鹿见她这副可怜巴巴的模样，心中到底有些不忍，沉吟了一回，道：“罢了，看在你唤了我一声大仙的份上，我便传你一个法门。”
小参猛地抬起头来，两眼放光：“当真？”
白鹿将鹿首一昂：“我空山客何时说过虚话？你且坐好了，仔细听着。”
小参忙不迭地盘膝坐下，双手按在膝头上，腰杆挺得笔直，一双乌黑的眼珠子一眨不眨地盯着白鹿，那架势比方才听陶潜讲课时认真了百倍不止。
白鹿在她面前卧下身来，将那一对白玉鹿角微低垂，正色道：“你是草木之属，根基在木，命中带土。我传你这门法，唤作木性金情同归土丹法。此法不走寻常炼气的路数，专取天地间木气与土气交汇之处，引入丹田，化为己用。
你本就是吞吐日月精华的，如今不过是换个法子，将那散乱精华归拢成一团真元，日积月累，凝聚不散。修至大成炼成金丹之时，便是地仙之境，可与天地同寿。”
小参听得两眼发直，张着小嘴，半晌方道：“地……地仙？”
白鹿打了个响鼻：“怎的，嫌低了不成？”
小参连摆手，急道：“不嫌不嫌！地仙已是了不得了！我从前连想也不敢想！”
白鹿道：“那便闭了眼，安心记着。”
说罢，将口诀一句一句念将出来。那口诀并不算长，前后不过三百余字，只是其中多有拗口之处，小参听了两遍，尚有七八句记不真切。
白鹿耐着性子，又从头念了三遍，直到小参将那三百余字倒背如流，方才住口。
小参睁开眼来，在心中默默将口诀过了一遍，确认无误，方才从地上跳起来，冲着白鹿深拜了三拜，口中道：“多谢空山客大仙传法之恩！小参无以为报，日后若有用得着小参的地方，大仙只管开口，赴汤蹈火，绝不推辞！”
白鹿站起身来，将那雪白的尾巴甩了两甩，嘴角又翘起来，嘴上却道：“行了行了，莫要酸溜溜的，不过是个丹法罢了，也不是什么厉害金丹，最厉害的丹法还是我老爷的金丹大道。
可惜你学不得，你五众未伏，便是想学老爷也不会传。你也莫说什么报答之恩，一个巴掌大的小鬼，能替我做甚么？倒不如把这法门好生修炼，少在外头丢人现眼，便算对得住我了。”
小参重点头，攥着小拳头，满脸都是劫后余生又逢甘霖的欢喜。她心中暗道：“我在这深山中白修了千年，不想今日撞入这鬼谷山，竟一日之内得了安身之所，又得了正经法门。当真是吉人自有天相！”

白鹿将那鹿角上挂着的红果子晃了两晃，转过身去，四蹄无声，往那松林深处行去。走了几步，又回过头来，道：“口诀记牢了便好。头三日莫要急躁，寻个土木二气浓郁的所在，静心行功。若有不明之处，你在这后山松林里唤我三声，我自会来。”
说罢，白色身影一闪，已没入林间，不见踪迹。
小参站在原地，呆了好一会儿，方才回过神来。她低头看了看自己两只沾满泥土的小手，又摸了摸脸上那些尚未干透的泪痕，忽地咧嘴笑了起来，蹦跳跳地顺着山道往回跑去，嘴里念有词，正是在默诵那木性金情同归土丹法的口诀。
山外三十里处，有一条黄土官道，道旁尽是枯草败叶，车辙深浅浅碾过不知多少年。这日午后，日头偏西，道上走来三个中年汉子，皆作炼气士打扮。
当先一人身量中等，面目清瘦，颌下蓄着一绺短须，背上斜背一柄桃木剑，剑鞘上缠着几道黄符纸，走起路来哗啦作响。
此人名唤何章，左手里托着一面铜罗盘，盘上指针颤巍巍，始终朝着东北方向打转。
何章停下步子，将罗盘举至眼前细看了一回，指着前方那座苍翠大山，沉声道：“不错了，那人参精的气息到了此处便断了。它必是遁入了这座山中，藏匿起来。”
后头二人闻言，亦停了步子。左边那个生得膀大腰圆，虎背熊腰，腰间悬着一口短刀，一张国字脸上满是风霜之色，唤作王飞。
右边那个却瘦长如竹竿，背着个药箱，手中拄一根铁杖，双目精亮，名唤陆长留。
他三人不是方士，却是那深山老林中的炼气士，早年间偶然入山，遇了位仙人，那仙人见他们根器不错，也有向道之心，便勉强将他三人收入山中，传了些炼气的本事。
不过后来他们在山中修了两百来年，没有什成就只会练些延寿的丹药，虽延了一百多年的寿数，却也难以修成人仙，若再不入门，恐怕也就寿命尽了，吃丹药也没有用，就将他们放了出去，看能不能寻到个什么机缘。
原以为他们三人靠山中学这的练气本事也能闯出一番天地来，结果不知道是哪个该千刀杀的人，有教无类，广收门徒，弄出了一大批方士而来，搅乱了世道，原本他们能当国君的供奉，现在快速贬值，变成了那些贵族的客卿。
如果只是这些，那也就罢了。可那些方士，厉害的是真厉害，那差的也是真的差，甚至有时候连忙都帮不上，净添些倒忙，若是组队去除妖，找那些个方士，全靠赌，赌到了真厉害的人，甚至不需要他们出手，是个法术就能将那些个妖怪给咒死。..la
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Journey to the West: Just about to dissect the corpse and become an immortal, the monkey comes to find the first volume: Default Chapter 265 Qi Refiner (..la) Bai Lu took two steps, suddenly lost his smug expression, tilted his head and looked at the small ginseng again, and said: "Let me ask you, what kind of method have you practiced since you have transformed into a plant and tree body?"
When Xiao Shen heard this, she tangled her two little hands together and murmured: "I...I don't have any method. I just find a hilltop with abundant spiritual energy, swallow some moonlight at night, and collect some sun essence during the day. I have been practicing this for thousands of years."
The white deer slapped its front hooves on the ground and exhaled a breath of white air from its nose: "No wonder you are so helpless! After thousands of years of cultivation, you are not even as good as a human immortal. If you meet those powerful human immortals, I am afraid you will only be arrested and taken to refine elixirs. If you practice like this for another thousand years, you will be nothing more than a wandering cultivator. If you encounter someone with more powerful methods, they will still take you. You are not helpless."
Xiao Shen's face turned red when she was talking about it. She lowered her head and did not dare to answer the words. She only used her toes to rub the pine needles on the ground.
Seeing her pitiful look, Bai Lu couldn't bear it. He pondered for a while and said, "That's all, for the sake of calling me a great immortal, I will teach you a method."
Xiao Shen suddenly raised her head, her eyes shining: "Seriously?"
The white deer raised its head and said, "When did I, the empty mountain guest, ever tell lies? Just sit still and listen carefully."
Xiao Shen hurriedly sat down cross-legged, put her hands on her knees, straightened her waist, and stared at Bai Lu with a pair of black eyes unblinking, her posture was a hundred times more serious than when she was listening to Tao Qian's lecture.
The white deer lay down in front of her, lowered his pair of white jade antlers slightly, and said sternly: "You are a member of vegetation, with your roots in wood, and your destiny is earth. I teach you this method, which is called the Wood Nature, Metal, and Feeling Return to Earth Alchemy Method. This method does not follow the ordinary path of refining qi, but specifically takes the intersection of wood energy and earth energy between heaven and earth, introduces it into the Dantian, and turns it into your own use.
You were originally swallowing the essence of the sun and the moon, but now you are just using another method to gather the scattered essence into a ball of true energy, which will accumulate over time and never disperse. When you reach great perfection and refine the golden elixir, you will be in the realm of earthly immortals and can live as long as heaven and earth. "
Xiao Shen's eyes widened when she heard this, her mouth opened, and she said after a while: "Earth... Earth Immortal?"
Bai Lu snorted: "Why, do you think it's too low?"
Xiao Shen waved her hands and said anxiously: "Don't mind it, don't mind it! The Earth Immortal is already amazing! I didn't even dare to think about it before!"
Bai Lu said: "Then close your eyes and remember with peace of mind."
After that, recite the formula sentence by sentence. The formula was not too long, only about 300 words, but there were many awkward parts in it. After listening to it twice, Xiao Shen still couldn't remember seven or eight sentences clearly.
Bai Lu patiently recited it three times from the beginning. He didn't stop until Xiao Shen had memorized the more than three hundred words.
Xiao Shen opened her eyes and silently went through the mantra in her mind to confirm that it was correct. Then she jumped up from the ground, bowed deeply to the white deer three times, and said, "Thank you so much for the kindness of Master Kongshanke in teaching the Dharma! Xiao Shen can't repay you. If there is a place where Xiao Shen is useful in the future, the Great Immortal will just open your mouth and go through fire and water, and will never refuse!"
Bai Lu stood up, swung his snow-white tail twice, raised the corners of his mouth again, and said: "Okay, okay, don't be sour, it's just an elixir, not a powerful golden elixir. The most powerful elixir is my master's golden elixir."
It's a pity that you can't learn it. Even if you want to learn from the master, you won't be able to teach it. Don't say anything about repaying your kindness. What can a slap-sized brat do for me? It's better to practice this method well and avoid embarrassing others outside, then you can be considered worthy of me. "
Xiao Shen nodded, clenched her fists, and her face was full of joy that she would be able to enjoy the rain again after such a disaster. She thought to herself: "I have been cultivating in this deep mountain for thousands of years in vain, and I don't want to crash into this Guigu Mountain today.", I actually found a place to stay and learned the orthodox Dharma in one day. It’s true that auspicious people have their own destiny! "
The white deer shook the red fruit hanging on its antlers, turned around, and walked towards the depths of the pine forest silently with all four hooves. After walking a few steps, he turned back and said, "Just remember the formula. Don't be impatient in the first three days, find a place with strong earth and wood Qi, and practice the exercises quietly. If there is anything unclear, just call me three times in the pine forest at the back of the mountain and I will come. "
After saying that, the white figure flashed and disappeared into the forest without a trace.
Xiao Shen stood there for a long time before coming back to her senses. She lowered her head and looked at her two little hands covered with soil, then touched the tears on her face that had not yet dried up. She suddenly grinned and ran back along the mountain road, murmuring the formula of the wood-nature-gold-love-return-to-earth elixir.
Thirty miles outside the mountain, there is a loess official road. The side of the road is full of dead grass and fallen leaves, and the road has deep ruts for countless years. In the afternoon of this day, as the sun turned to the west, three middle-aged men came walking on the road, all dressed as Qi refiners.
The first man was of medium height, with a thin face, and a short beard under his chin. He carried a mahogany sword slung across his back, with several yellow talismans wrapped around the scabbard. It made a clattering sound as he walked.
This man's name is He Zhang, and he is holding a copper compass in his left hand. The pointer on the compass is trembling, always spinning towards the northeast.
He Zhang stopped, raised the compass in front of his eyes and took a closer look, pointed at the green mountain in front of him, and said in a deep voice: "That's right, the breath of the ginseng essence stopped here. It must have escaped into this mountain and hid. "
Hearing this, the two people behind also stopped. The one on the left is broad-shouldered and round-waisted, with a strong back and a strong waist, a short sword hanging from his waist, and a face full of wind and frost. His name is Wang Fei.
The one on the right is as thin as a bamboo pole, carrying a medicine box on his back, holding an iron staff in his hand, with bright eyes, and his name is Lu Changliu.
The three of them were not alchemists, but Qi refiners in the deep mountains and old forests. In their early years, they accidentally entered the mountains and met an immortal. Seeing that they had good abilities and a desire to follow the Tao, the immortal reluctantly took the three of them into the mountains and taught them some Qi refining skills.
But then they practiced in the mountains for more than two hundred years without any success and could only practice some life-extending elixirs. Although their lifespans were extended for more than a hundred years, it was difficult for them to become immortals. If they didn't get started, their lifespan would be over. Taking elixirs was of no use, so they were released to see if they could find any opportunity.
I originally thought that the three of them could make a name for themselves with their qi-training skills at the high school they supported, but it turned out that they were the ones who deserved to be killed with a thousand swords. They were well-educated and recruited many disciples, creating a large number of alchemists who came and disrupted the world. They were originally able to be worshiped by the king, but now their value has rapidly depreciated, and they have become the guests of those nobles.
If that's all, then that's it. But those alchemists, those who are really powerful are really bad, and those who are bad are really bad. Sometimes they can't even help, which is a waste of time. If they form a team to eliminate monsters, finding those alchemists depends entirely on gambling. If you get the really powerful ones, you don't even need them to take action, just a spell can kill those monsters. ..la
